A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same RLGF study. The main text, equations, Figures 1–4, Tables 1–7, Appendices A–C, and checklist support reliable comparison. The additional page in v2 reflects bibliography expansion.

before.justification: v1 reports original perception-model evaluations, RLGF video-generation and downstream detection results, and reward-component and hyperparameter ablations in the main text and Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the main comparisons in Tables 1–4 and supplementary results in Tables 5–7.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.4 retain the same latent-space windowed optimization, LoRA adaptation, micro-decoding, perception networks, and hierarchical geometric rewards. No algorithmic component or objective changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same nuScenes and Occ3D-nuScenes coverage for driving-video generation, geometric perception, occupancy prediction, and downstream detection. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 1–6 retain the same perception baselines, video-generation comparators, and detector-reward comparison. Panacea, Drive-WM, MagicDrive-v2, and DiVE remain in the corresponding comparisons; newly cited works are not added experimental baselines.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendices A–B retain the same data splits, GeoScores/FVD/detection metrics, training procedures, and downstream detector settings. The 30-step diffusion setup, window size 5, and other stated experimental configurations are unchanged.

E4.justification: The reward-component ablation in Table 4, detector-reward comparison in Table 6, and window-size, reward-weight, and window-position analyses in Table 7 are unchanged. Appendix B retains the same detector robustness analysis and qualitative examples.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests for the experimental results. Both checklists answer No to statistical-significance reporting.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–7 and the qualitative examples match. For example, Table 2 retains DiVE and DiVE+RLGF mAP values of 25.75 and 31.42, while Table 5 retains their StreamPETR mAP values of 29.19 and 33.94.

T1.justification: Equations 1–13, including the optimization objectives, perception losses, and reward definitions, are unchanged. Neither version introduces formal theorems or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets, and conclusion retain the same geometric-distortion diagnosis, GeoScores and RLGF contributions, plug-and-play scope, and performance claims.

C2.justification: The interpretations of geometric fidelity, downstream detection gains, and complementary reward components are unchanged. Appendix C retains the same limitations concerning perception-model dependence, computation, reward balancing, generalization, and GeoScores coverage.

D1.justification: Appendix A preserves the same pseudo-label preparation, model architectures, LoRA rank, optimizer settings, training durations, and eight-A100 hardware disclosure. Both checklists still describe code release as future work; the new funding acknowledgment adds no reproducibility information.

R1.justification: v2 adds 15 references, including PanoLoRA, ReconDreamer, ReconDreamer-RL, WonderTurbo, and Matrix-3D, through expanded citation groups in Sections 2.1–2.2. Existing references are retained, but there is no accompanying substantive comparative discussion or revision of the claimed research gap.

P1.justification: v2 adds a first-page funding acknowledgment and updates citation numbering while preserving the scientific prose and section order. Table 6 retains DiVE [16], which becomes an incorrect reference after renumbering; DiVE is listed as [18] in v2.

P2.justification: The expanded funding footnote and tighter spacing reflow text on pages 1–3, while the longer bibliography shifts the checklist pagination. Figures 1–4 and Tables 1–7 retain their visual content, structure, and placement.

improvement.justification: v2 adds funding credit and broader citation coverage, but the new citations receive no substantive comparative discussion. Methods, empirical evidence, appendix analyses, limitations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged. The stale DiVE citation in Table 6 introduces a small referencing defect; these limited editorial benefits and defects leave overall paper quality essentially unchanged.
